summary: Enable mode passwords can be provided with --ask-become-pass or ansible_become_password, which should be encrypted with Vault rather than stored in plain text.
questions: How do I give Ansible the enable password for a switch?

answer_card.title: Enable mode passwords
answer_card.answer_md: Use `--ask-become-pass` on the command line, or set `ansible_become_password` (encrypt it with **Ansible Vault**, never plain text).
